source_import.detail: PR #4335 targets parseBatchArtifactURL so a versioned official artifact query can retain its identity through fetch. No Gong-specific source-import change is planned.

output_preservation.detail: Gong declarations require ordinary provider values to remain exact even when equal to configured credential material. Shared result projections collision-mask those values; foundation issue #4321 owns the generic red/green correction.

live_certification.detail: persisted App authentication, one bounded ETL read, and one bounded typed direct read passed; the next clean run is prepared in LIVE-CERTIFICATION-RUNBOOK.md and stays paused until the versioned-artifact foundation lands. It must also use provider-neutral foundation #4337 so an account-scoped base URL cannot enter generated evidence.
